"""第 63 轮接口来源副本：仅在 staging 中写入，保留生产源原始行尾。"""
from pathlib import Path
import ast
import difflib
import hashlib
import json

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DATA = ROOT / "knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm"
PLAN_SHA = "5f134f630f8f969097c2b9c2b85912a89b4f20ef224043303367d43754d1dd06"
BASELINE_SHA = "22f1b40f08a37ad1dcb62bd7a047581d637939c8dcd1cf0123102a64617a3048"
FILES = (
    "include/solver/detail/normal_cholesky.hpp", "include/solver/ipm_options.hpp",
    "src/ipm.cpp", "src/main.cpp", "scripts/benchmark.py", "scripts/compare_lp.py",
    "tests/test_ipm.cpp", "tests/test_cli.py", "tests/test_compare_lp.py",
)


def sha(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()


plan_bytes = (DATA / "v66-plan.json").read_bytes()
baseline_bytes = (DATA / "v66-baseline-check.json").read_bytes()
assert sha(plan_bytes) == PLAN_SHA
assert sha(baseline_bytes) == BASELINE_SHA
plan = json.loads(plan_bytes)
baseline = json.loads(baseline_bytes)
assert set(FILES) | {"src/normal_cholesky.cpp", "tests/test_normal_cholesky.cpp"} == set(plan["changed_source_files"])
originals = {name: (ROOT / name).read_bytes() for name in FILES}
assert all(sha(value) == baseline["files"][name] for name, value in originals.items())
sources = {name: value.decode("utf-8") for name, value in originals.items()}
edits = {name: [] for name in FILES}


def replace(name, old, new, count=1):
    source = sources[name]
    assert source.count(old) == count, (name, old[:120], source.count(old), count)
    positions = []
    start = 0
    for _ in range(count):
        position = source.index(old, start)
        positions.append(position)
        start = position + len(old)
    for position in reversed(positions):
        source = source[:position] + new + source[position + len(old):]
        edits[name].append((position, old, new))
    sources[name] = source


def insert_after_line(name, needle, addition):
    lines = [line for line in sources[name].splitlines(keepends=True) if needle in line]
    assert len(lines) == 1, (name, needle)
    old = lines[0]
    ending = "\r\n" if old.endswith("\r\n") else "\n"
    replace(name, old, old + addition.replace("\n", ending) + ending)


name = "include/solver/detail/normal_cholesky.hpp"
replace(name, "enum class NormalCholeskyKernel { eigen, cholmod_supernodal };",
        "enum class NormalCholeskyKernel { eigen, cholmod_supernodal, cholmod_supernodal_aat };")
name = "include/solver/ipm_options.hpp"
insert_after_line(name, "// normal_cholmod 保持原 Gram", "  // normal_cholmod_aat 保持原 AMD 和结构预算，将矩形输入的 Gram 数值乘积交由 CHOLMOD 完成。")
name = "src/ipm.cpp"
insert_after_line(name, 'const bool normal_cholmod =', '    const bool normal_cholmod_aat = options.ipm.linear_solver == "normal_cholmod_aat";')
replace(name, '|| normal_refined || normal_cholmod;', '|| normal_refined || normal_cholmod || normal_cholmod_aat;')
replace(name, 'normal_cholmod ? detail::NormalCholeskyKernel::cholmod_supernodal : detail::NormalCholeskyKernel::eigen);',
        'normal_cholmod_aat ? detail::NormalCholeskyKernel::cholmod_supernodal_aat :\n                normal_cholmod ? detail::NormalCholeskyKernel::cholmod_supernodal : detail::NormalCholeskyKernel::eigen);')
replace(name, 'result.ipm_factor_backend = normal_cholmod ?',
        'result.ipm_factor_backend = normal_cholmod_aat ? "normal_cholmod_aat" : normal_cholmod ?')
replace(name, 'options.ipm.linear_solver != "normal_cholmod") {',
        'options.ipm.linear_solver != "normal_cholmod" && options.ipm.linear_solver != "normal_cholmod_aat") {')
replace(name, 'normal_refined 或 normal_cholmod");', 'normal_refined、normal_cholmod 或 normal_cholmod_aat");')
replace(name, 'options.ipm.linear_solver == "normal_cholmod") &&',
        'options.ipm.linear_solver == "normal_cholmod" || options.ipm.linear_solver == "normal_cholmod_aat") &&')
replace(name, 'return "ipm-cpu-0.47.0";', 'return "ipm-cpu-0.53.0";')
name = "src/main.cpp"
replace(name, '|normal_cholmod]', '|normal_cholmod|normal_cholmod_aat]')
replace(name, 'value != "normal_cholmod")', 'value != "normal_cholmod" && value != "normal_cholmod_aat")')
replace(name, 'normal_refined 或 normal_cholmod");', 'normal_refined、normal_cholmod 或 normal_cholmod_aat");')
name = "scripts/benchmark.py"
replace(name, '"normal_refined", "normal_cholmod")', '"normal_refined", "normal_cholmod", "normal_cholmod_aat")')
replace(name, '    if getattr(args, prefix + "ipm_linear_solver") != "normal_cholmod":',
        '    linear_solver = getattr(args, prefix + "ipm_linear_solver")\n    if linear_solver not in ("normal_cholmod", "normal_cholmod_aat"):')
replace(name, '"ipm-linear-solver normal_cholmod 要求 "', '"ipm-linear-solver " + linear_solver + " 要求 "')
replace(name, '"ipm-linear-solver normal_cholmod 不支持 "', '"ipm-linear-solver " + linear_solver + " 不支持 "')
description = '；normal_cholmod_aat 保持相同 AMD 和结构预算，使用 CHOLMOD 矩形输入数值乘积'
replace(name, '使用 CHOLMOD 超节点分解")', '使用 CHOLMOD 超节点分解' + description + '")')
name = "scripts/compare_lp.py"
replace(name, 'normal_refined、normal_cholmod；', 'normal_refined、normal_cholmod、normal_cholmod_aat；')
replace(name, '使用 CHOLMOD 超节点分解")', '使用 CHOLMOD 超节点分解' + description + '")')
name = "tests/test_ipm.cpp"
replace(name, 'if (options.ipm.linear_solver == "normal_cholmod") {',
        'if (options.ipm.linear_solver == "normal_cholmod" || options.ipm.linear_solver == "normal_cholmod_aat") {')
replace(name, '? "factorhighs" : "normal_cholmod"),', '? "factorhighs" : options.ipm.linear_solver),')
replace(name, '"normal_cholmod"}) {', '"normal_cholmod", "normal_cholmod_aat"}) {', count=3)
replace(name, 'if (mode == "normal_cholmod") {', 'if (mode == "normal_cholmod" || mode == "normal_cholmod_aat") {')
replace(name, '// 一列连接大量等式，原始矩阵稀疏，但显式 Gram 展开会超过既定工作预算。',
        '// 一列连接大量等式，原始矩阵稀疏，但会超过两种 CHOLMOD 路径共同保留的 Gram 结构贡献预算。')
name = "tests/test_cli.py"
insert_after_line(name, '(self.minimum, "normal_cholmod", "on", 8 / 3))',
                  '        cases += ((self.minimum, "normal_cholmod_aat", "on", 8 / 3),)')
replace(name, '(self.minimum, "normal_cholmod", 8 / 3)):',
        '(self.minimum, "normal_cholmod", 8 / 3),\n                                         (self.minimum, "normal_cholmod_aat", 8 / 3)):', count=2)
replace(name, 'if linear == "normal_cholmod":', 'if linear in ("normal_cholmod", "normal_cholmod_aat"):', count=2)
replace(name, 'self.assertEqual(result["ipm_factor_backend"], "normal_cholmod")',
        'self.assertEqual(result["ipm_factor_backend"], linear)', count=2)
insert_after_line(name, 'self.assertEqual(result["options"]["ipm"]["linear_accuracy"], "homogeneous_repair")',
                  '                self.assertEqual(result["options"]["ipm"]["linear_solver"], linear)\n                if linear in ("normal_cholmod", "normal_cholmod_aat"):\n                    self.assertEqual(result["ipm_factor_backend"], linear)\n                    self.assertEqual(result["ipm_structural_fallbacks"], 0)')
replace(name, '"normal_refined", "normal_cholmod"]:', '"normal_refined", "normal_cholmod", "normal_cholmod_aat"]:')
insert_after_line(name, '("--backend", "pdlp", "--ipm-linear-solver", "normal_cholmod"),',
                  '                          ("--backend", "ipm", "--ipm-linear-solver", "normal_cholmod_aat"),\n                          ("--backend", "ipm", "--ipm-linear-solver", "normal_cholmod_aat",\n                           "--ipm-singleton-elimination", "off"),\n                          ("--backend", "ipm", "--ipm-linear-solver", "normal_cholmod_aat",\n                           "--ipm-singleton-elimination", "on", "--ipm-dynamic-regularization", "on"),\n                          ("--backend", "highs", "--ipm-linear-solver", "normal_cholmod_aat"),\n                          ("--backend", "pdlp", "--ipm-linear-solver", "normal_cholmod_aat"),')
start = sources[name].index('    def test_ipm_cholmod_zero_time_keeps_requested_backend_without_factor_work(self):')
end = sources[name].index('    def test_maximum_retains_original_sense(self):', start)
old = sources[name][start:end]
lines = old.splitlines(keepends=True)
ending = "\r\n" if lines[0].endswith("\r\n") else "\n"
new = lines[0] + '        for linear in ("normal_cholmod", "normal_cholmod_aat"):' + ending
new += ''.join('    ' + line.replace('"normal_cholmod"', 'linear') if line.strip() else line for line in lines[1:])
replace(name, old, new)
name = "tests/test_compare_lp.py"
replace(name, '("linear_solver", "normal_cholmod", "normal_augmented")):',
        '("linear_solver", "normal_cholmod", "normal_augmented"),\n                                        ("linear_solver", "normal_cholmod_aat", "normal_cholmod")):')
replace(name, 'requested in ("normal", "normal_cholmod")', 'requested in ("normal", "normal_cholmod", "normal_cholmod_aat")')
insert_after_line(name, '("normal_cholmod", None), (None, "normal_cholmod"),',
                  '                 ("normal_cholmod_aat", None), (None, "normal_cholmod_aat"),\n                 ("normal_cholmod_aat", "normal_cholmod"), ("normal_cholmod", "normal_cholmod_aat"),')
replace(name, '"normal_refined", "normal_cholmod") else "off"',
        '"normal_refined", "normal_cholmod", "normal_cholmod_aat") else "off"')
start = sources[name].index('        for backend, switches in cases:', sources[name].index('    def test_cholmod_requires_its_own_singleton_switch'))
end = sources[name].index('    def test_inexact_mode_preserves_counts', start)
old = sources[name][start:end]
ending = "\r\n" if old.splitlines(keepends=True)[0].endswith("\r\n") else "\n"
new = '        for linear in ("normal_cholmod", "normal_cholmod_aat"):' + ending
new += ''.join('    ' + line.replace('["--ipm-linear-solver", "normal_cholmod"]', '["--ipm-linear-solver", linear]').replace('self.subTest(tool=', 'self.subTest(linear=linear, tool=') if line.strip() else line for line in old.splitlines(keepends=True))
replace(name, old, new)
insert_after_line(name, '("ipm", ["--ipm-linear-solver", "normal_cholmod", "--ipm-singleton-elimination", "on"], "ipm_requested_options", "linear_solver", "normal_cholmod"),',
                  '                 ("ipm", ["--ipm-linear-solver", "normal_cholmod_aat", "--ipm-singleton-elimination", "on"], "ipm_requested_options", "linear_solver", "normal_cholmod_aat"),')

# 在任何来源副本写出前，先核所有声明改动可以逐字节逆转、Python 可以解析。
for name, source in sources.items():
    restored = source
    for position, old, new in reversed(edits[name]):
        assert restored[position:position + len(new)] == new, name
        restored = restored[:position] + old + restored[position + len(new):]
    assert restored.encode("utf-8") == originals[name], name
    if name.endswith(".py"):
        ast.parse(source, filename=name)
    assert (ROOT / name).read_bytes() == originals[name], name
assert 'cls.benchmark.platform.platform()' in sources['tests/test_cli.py']
assert 'homogeneous_extended' not in sources['src/ipm.cpp']
assert 'std::string linear_solver = "qdldl";' in sources['include/solver/ipm_options.hpp']

diff = ''.join(''.join(difflib.unified_diff(originals[name].decode('utf-8').splitlines(keepends=True),
                                          sources[name].splitlines(keepends=True),
                                          fromfile='a/' + name, tofile='b/' + name)) for name in FILES)
for name, source in sources.items():
    destination = OUT / name
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination.write_bytes(source.encode('utf-8'))
(OUT / 'diff.patch').write_bytes(diff.encode('utf-8'))
driver = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
manifest = {
    'schema': 'v66_integration_staging_1', 'plan_sha256': PLAN_SHA,
    'baseline_sha256': BASELINE_SHA, 'implementation_ancestor': '当前 v57 来源加已有平台预热',
    'files': [{'path': name, 'input_sha256': sha(originals[name]),
               'output_sha256': sha(sources[name].encode('utf-8')),
               'declared_replacement_count': len(edits[name])} for name in FILES],
    'diff_sha256': sha(diff.encode('utf-8')),
    'driver_source': driver.decode('utf-8'), 'driver_sha256': sha(driver),
    'static_checks': {'inverse_byte_exact': True, 'python_ast_parsed': 4,
                      'production_sources_unchanged': True, 'platform_prewarm_retained': True,
                      'default_linear_solver_unchanged': True, 'no_v62_accuracy_inherited': True},
    'scope': '枚举、显式选项贯通、后端报告、版本和端到端回归；内核另由 v66-kernel 提供。',
    'test_scope': ['HSD strict/scaled/repair 与固定列恢复的原模型验收及实际后端标签',
                   '共同结构贡献超限回退、零预算、数值失败不回退及非法组合',
                   'CLI 显式选择与零时间；benchmark/compare 两侧独立参数与报告一致性'],
    'not_run': ['构建', 'C++ 测试', 'Python 测试', 'LP', '全来源或二进制哈希'],
}
(OUT / 'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'passed': True, 'file_count': len(FILES), 'manifest': str(OUT / 'manifest.json'),
                  'manifest_sha256': sha((OUT / 'manifest.json').read_bytes())}, ensure_ascii=False))
